every_frame.claim_all_frames: only if analyzed_frame_count equals decoded_frame_count and missing_ranges is empty

transcript_rules: speaker labels are provisional until human attribution
numbers units grid names and negation preserved
global timecode retained when splitting audio
no speech segment fabricated across a gap
evidence_link_rules: all ranges bounded by original duration
frame PTS comes from decoder; frameIndex/fps is insufficient for variable frame rate
derived image retains originalEvidenceId and derivationRunId
speech-only claims remain reported facts until corroborated
contradiction or poor visibility requires review; no automatic PASS/FAIL
confidence_rule: Model reference score, not calibrated probability or legal acceptance; confidence never bypasses authorized review.
retry_rule: New run with retryOfId; retain prior outputs and model/prompt/policy versions.
offline_rule: captureId deduplicates evidence; expectedVersion conflict goes to human resolution, never last-write-wins.
privacy_rule: Original access follows project/package/location/organization scope; redacted derivatives can be shared with source provenance retained.
provider_adapter: No model provider selected. Workers must return this normalized contract; model calls and media decoding are outside the reference runner.

rules: Original photo and exact run/model version are required.
A complete photo needs its own visually grounded candidate or explicit no_findings result.
Candidate and no_findings outcomes for the same photo conflict.
No-findings is a worker assessment, never an official acceptance result.
